description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelEditButton, which extends a base widget class and provides functionality to display an edit button in a subpanel within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM interface. It includes methods for rendering the header cell and list view element of the subpanel, generating HTML with JavaScript event handlers tied to the subpanel's context.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelEditButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering an edit button in a subpanel list view, allowing inline editing of related records.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns an empty string; used for rendering header cells in the subpanel list view.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML for an edit link button within the subpanel, including JavaScript handlers for UI interactions.
